Stage 1 component distributions. The figure uses layer 1 molecular data. (A) Component 1
sample-coordinate distribution. (B) Component 2 sample-coordinate distribution. Facets show
components 1-2 in decomposition order; stored densities summarize sample-coordinate
distributions; fine rugs show sample coordinates; dotted vertical lines mark zero. Categorical
metadata is shown by restrained density fills and solid outlines; fine sample rugs show
individual coordinates. The analysis unit is independent biological observation; the design is
cross-sectional; the estimand is the descriptive distribution of sample coordinates. No
component-selection threshold is applied. This descriptive gallery does not rank or nominate a
biological coordinate.
